items.name: Nepal Open 2016

venue.name: [SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Kavre](http://www.sosnepal.org.np/where-we-help/kavre/sos-hermann-geminer-school-kavre)
venue.details: On the second floor of the school building

items.information: Nepal Open 2016 is open to citizens of all countries, but only Nepali participants can win prizes and titles. The venue is located in SOS Children's Village Kavre, opposite to Kathmandu University and about 26km from the central region of Capital Kathmandu. Seat Limit is 80, register fast, registration fee is NRs 250 ($2.5) for 3x3 then for all other events it's NRs 60,($0.6). As the first official speedcubing competition in Nepal, here it comes!

items.name: Nepal Open 2018

venue.name: [Kathmandu University](http://ku.edu.np/)
venue.details: Chinese Hall (Day 1), C.v Raman Auditorium (Day 2) follow the directions Indicated by the indicators from the main gate.

items.information: This competition is the third iteration of **Nepal Open (Nepali National Championship)** and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However, only **Nepalese participants** will be eligible for prizes and titles. यो प्रतियोगिता नेपाल ओपन (नेपाली राष्ट्रिय प्रतिस्पर्धा)को तेस्रो शृङ्खला हो र यो सबै राष्ट्रियताको प्रतियोगीका लागि खुला छ। तर उपाधि तथा पुरस्कार प्राप्त गर्न नेपाली प्रतियोगी मात्रै योग्य हुने छन्। Pre-registration on the WCA website is compulsory. All participants wishing to compete will have to register through this [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/register). डब्लूसीएको औपचारिक वेबसाइटमा अग्रिम दर्ता गर्न अनिवार्य रहेको छ। सहभागी हुन इच्छुक महानुभावहरूले यस [लिङ्कबाट](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/registe)दर्ता गर्नु होस् । Please make sure to check the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7837-travel) and [Accomodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7836-accommodation) tabs.
